outcome: Intensity of subacute low back pain (VAS)
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery (n=26) and a control group of women who did not experience pregnancy or anesthesia (n=12).
finding: While all three types of anesthesia for cesarean delivery were associated with increased intensity of subacute low back pain compared to controls, there were no significant differences between the three anesthesia types in pain intensity or disability.
